Use case: precise-object-edit.
The reference is the EXACT EDIT TARGET from an existing Grenoble pixel-art game. The user LIKES its COLORS, MATERIALS AND VISUAL STYLE. They dislike that the windows and doors look compressed/stretched. Change ONLY the proportions and placement of the openings to correct this.
Preserve the roof outline, chimneys, roof tiles, eave at source y128, exterior wall shape, stone corner courses, plaster palette, all original ornaments and exact overall HEIGHT:WIDTH aspect ratio. This is NOT a new style or a different building. Edit its existing windows and doors, repainting wall gaps with matching original plaster.
Doors must have realistic leaf width-to-height around1:2.25; window glazing around1:1.8 to1:2.1. Keep stone arches round, NOT flattened ovals. Every opening is drawn at a natural proportion and individually repositioned within the fixed facade. Never stretch the entire facade or squeeze all its elements to fill the rectangle. No shops in these residential base assets.
Maintain hard-edged coarse pixel clusters compatible with a4px source pixel grid, original muted colors, orthographic straight-on slightly elevated camera, no visible side wall, no perspective distortion. TRUE transparent background only outside the original roof silhouette; no ground, shadows outside sprite, text, grids or watermark.
EXACT CANVAS EXTENT, tight framing, building touches bottom and both outside edges. No added padding.
Target canvas width256px by height384px (these are canonical coordinates, scale all coordinates consistently in a higher resolution output).
ONE STOREY, narrow house. Keep one centered stone-arched wooden entrance and one shuttered window on each side. At the canonical 256x384 size the door LEAF should be about 56px wide x128px tall, with a rounded stone arch above it (outer frame about80px wide). Each window GLAZING should be about36px wide x72px tall; window frames and side shutters add width. Place the two window units at left and right without squeezing them horizontally. Leave comfortable yellow plaster around the openings. Roof ends at y128, door threshold at y368. No additional storey.
